questions.primary_text: Participation to a Study of the impact of AI and explainable AI to Human Performance at a Pattern Identification Task
questions.secondary_text:
Project Objectives

The aim of this project is to study the impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and explainable AI on human performance in carrying out a decision-making task.

What Is Expected of You

You will need to take decisions related to the content of images of geometrical symbols. For each image presented to you, will have to answer a question within a limited time. Here is an example of question that could be asked : ”In the image, is there exactly four squares?”.

You are expected to perform as well as possible. Your performance will be evaluated based on the number of correct answers during the main experimental phase, and your bonus remuneration will be calculated based on your performance.

The protocol will start with an introductive phase, in which you will have the opportunity to train for the tasks. Your performance will only start to be recorded during the main experimental phase.

You will also be expected to answer several surveys during the protocol.

Depending on your random assignment into a group, you might receive the assistance of an AI to perform the tasks.

Your Right to Withdraw from the Study

You have the right to withdraw from the study at any time.

Your Right to Ask Questions

You have the right to ask questions during the study. You can also report issues if you detect any.

Confidentiality and Privacy

The information collected in this form is recorded in a file by Jules Leguy for research purposes, specifically to study human performance in a decision making task. The legal basis for this data processing is your consent.

The collected data will only be shared with the following recipients:

  • Jules Leguy
  • Andon Tchechmedjiev

The data will be kept for five years after the scientific publication (expected in 2026).

You may request access to your personal data, request corrections, or exercise your right to restrict the processing of your data. For more information on your rights, consult the CNIL website.

The right to data deletion is excluded during the retention period, as deletion would compromise the research.

To exercise these rights or ask questions regarding data processing within this framework, you may contact: andon.tchechmedjiev@mines-ales.fr.

If, after contacting us, you believe that your “Informatics and Liberties” rights have not been respected, you may submit a complaint to the CNIL (French Data Protection Authority).

Expected Benefits of the Study

Your remuneration will contain a fixed part that will depend on the time taken by the whole group of participants (the median time) at an hourly rate of $X, as well as a variable time that will entirely depend on your performance on the tasks of the main experimental phase. For these tasks, you will receive $0.XX per right answer. As there will be N questions, the bonus remuneration will range between $0 and $X.

Possible Risks

The risks involved in these tests are no different from those encountered when performing a standard computer task.

Right to Withdraw Consent

I understand that my participation in this research is voluntary and that I may refuse to participate. If I choose so, I am free to stop participating at any time, without having to provide justification. I will inform the Scientific Supervisor in writing at the following address: jules.leguy@mines-ales.fr.

Acknowledgment of Prior Information

The scientific supervisor has informed me of the nature and objectives of this research, as well as its procedures, potential benefits, and possible risks.

Acceptance of Conditions

I agree to comply with the constraints explained and specified in the information document, both to minimize risks and to ensure the proper completion of the protocol.

I agree to comply with the confidentiality rules applicable to this research, as explained to me beforehand.

Consent
answers: I have read and understand the information contained in this document, and I freely and knowingly consent to participate to this research project.
I do not consent to participate to this research project

title: Let's jump in
body_text:
You will now perform a first training session containing 2 tasks. Each task consist in answering a single question relative to the content of images of symbols of colors. For each task, you will have to answer the question for 6 different images. All tasks performed during the introduction will NOT count towards your score and bonus remuneration.

Please read the information above carefully, as you will not be able to return to this page once you click the button below.

title: Pattern identification tasks
body_text:
Some tasks will consist in searching whether a pattern can be found in an image or not.

Below is an example of such a task. The pattern to search for contains several symbols, and an empty cell with a question mark. When searching for the pattern, the cell with the question mark can be matched with any symbol (as in the image on the top, right), or it can also be matched with an empty cell (as in the image on the top, left). In the bottom image, the pattern does not appear.

Please read the information above carefully, as you will not be able to return to this page once you click the button below.

title: Protocol outline
body_text:
The protocol will last about 25 minutes and is organized as follows.


To continue your training, you will start the preparation phase, that contains two tasks which closely resemble those of the main experimental phase.

Then, the main experiment will start. It will be divided into 2 sessions. Each session consists in solving 4 tasks of 12 questions each, that will count towards your score and bonus remuneration. Every 2 tasks, you will have to answer a small survey about the tasks you just performed.

Finally, you will enter the closing phase, in which you will have to answer a final survey to conclude the protocol.

Notice that the tasks that will count towards your performance and thus your bonus remuneration are all in the Main experimental phase.

Please read the information above carefully, as you will not be able to return to this page once you click the button below.

title: AI assistant
body_text:
To assist you in performing the tasks, you will receive the help of an AI assistant. The AI has access to the same source image as you do, and will provide a suggestion on the decision to be made. Please note that the AI might make mistakes, and that the ultimate decision is always your responsability.

Here is an example of AI prediction for the search of the pattern below.

title: Introduction - Main experiment preparation
body_text:
You are now entering the preparation phase for the Main experiment, which is the last phase of the Introduction. You are about to perform 2 tasks of 12 questions each. These tasks closely resemble those in the main experimental phase and are intended to help you practice and prepare for the main phase.

As in the main experimental phase, you will have a limited amount of time to respond to each question. The allotted time for each question during this training phase is 45 seconds, and it will be shorter for the evaluated tasks in the main experiment.

As this is still a training phase, your score will not count towards your bonus remuneration.

Note that these training tasks are a good opportunity to interact with the AI’s outputs, as there will be less time for such analysis during the main experiment.

title: Main experiment
body_text:
The introduction is over. You are now entering the main experimental phase, in which your answers as well as your performance at the tasks will be recorded. Your performance during this phase will count towards your bonus remuneration. As a reminder, the structure of the experiment is described in the diagram below.


This phase is divided in 2 sessions. In each session, you must perform 2 tasks, answer a first survey about those tasks, then you must perform another 2 tasks and answer a second survey about those 2 latter tasks. There are no right or wrong answers to the survey questions; only your score during the tasks will count towards your bonus remuneration.

Please remind that you still have to answer the questions within an alloted time for each image. Responding faster does not improve your score. However, if you fail to respond within the alloted time, it will be counted as an error.

Please read the information above carefully as you will not be able to return to this page once you click the button below. You can take notes if you wish to.
